The best thing you’ve never heard.

Introducing the world’s best in-ear Active Noise Cancellation for the most immersive listening experience ever.13 Designed with an upgraded acoustic seal, AirPods Pro 3 automatically adapt to your environment and preferences. And new ultra-low-noise microphones remove even more unwanted sound. So you only hear what you want — in an unheard-of audio experience.

Removes up to

2x more

unwanted noise than AirPods Pro 21

unwanted noise than original AirPods Pro14

New ultra-low-noise microphones. Using advanced computational audio to remove more noise around you than ever, AirPods Pro 3 let you zone in (or out) when you need to. And five all-new ear tips — including an XXS option — fuse a thin layer of soft foam to the silicone shell to give you even better acoustic performance.

Voice Isolation. AirPods Pro 3 reduce background noise and isolate voices during calls. So whether you’re on the bus or in a café, every conversation is loud and clear.15

Adaptive Audio. AirPods Pro 3 combine Active Noise Cancellation with next-level Transparency, which makes your voice and the world around you sound even more natural and vibrant, intelligently adapting to your environment to prioritize what you need to hear, when you need to hear it.15

Conversation Awareness. AirPods Pro 3 can detect when you’re talking to someone nearby and automatically lower the volume of whatever you’re listening to. When you’re done, the volume goes right back to where you had it.15

Audio performance

The sound of science.

Powered by the Apple-designed H2 chip, AirPods Pro 3 feature a completely redesigned acoustic architecture that brings breathtaking, all-around-you audio to everything you listen to — from your pump-up playlist to your weekly FaceTime call with family.

A new multiport acoustic architecture with more precise airflow control — featuring an inward-facing microphone that points directly into the ear canal — delivers deeper bass, vivid vocal clarity, and a wider soundstage, so you never miss a note.

A custom-built driver and amplifier work with the H2 chip to create high-definition, three-dimensional sound, with superlow distortion during playback.

Personalized listening

For your ears only.

AirPods Pro 3 feature next-generation Adaptive EQ, which customizes a sound signature for your unique ear geometry and fit. And Personalized Volume uses machine learning to understand your listening patterns and adapt to your preferences over time.15

Adaptive EQ uses inward-facing microphones to tune music to your ears in real time. And with new Custom EQ, three intuitive controls let you easily personalize your perfect sound.

Personalized Spatial Audio uses the TrueDepth camera on your iPhone to create a custom profile based on the geometry of your head, delivering deeply immersive sound tailored to you.

Dynamic head tracking makes conversations feel like they’re happening in the same room — whether you’re gaming with friends or hosting a Group FaceTime call with family.4

Fitness

Introducing heart rate sensing.

All-new heart rate sensing helps you track your heart rate and calories burned during workouts.5 Using LEDs that pulse invisible light 256 times per second — and sensor fusion from the accelerometers — AirPods Pro 3 give you incredibly accurate data for up to 50 different workout types in the Fitness app. And with a more secure in-ear fit, you can go all out and they won’t come out.

Fitness app. With just AirPods Pro 3 and iPhone, you can dive into the new workout experience in the Fitness app, which includes things like walking, cycling, and HIIT. You can set your favorite music and podcasts to play automatically when you start a workout. With the new Apple Intelligence–enabled Workout Buddy feature, you can get personalized messages that keep you going.16 And with access to your Move ring — and even the Burn Bar in Fitness+ — you might just never stop.

IP57 dust, sweat, and water resistance. A first for AirPods, an IP57 rating means AirPods Pro 3 are more durable than ever.10 Thanks to precision engineering combined with robust testing, you can feel confident during even the sweatiest workouts.

Hearing Health

Check, aid, and help protect your hearing.

AirPods Pro 3 bring improvements to the world’s first end-to-end hearing health experience.7 Now you can take a scientifically validated Hearing Test in a broader range of background conditions. The Hearing Aid feature adds improved voice clarity, automatic Conversation Boost,8 and 67 percent more battery life in Transparency on a single charge.9 And active Hearing Protection helps prevent exposure to loud environmental noise.17

Learn more

4 more hours

for the Hearing Aid feature

9

Battery life. Hearing Aid users now get 67 percent more battery life in Transparency on a single charge. That’s a total of up to 10 hours, making it easier than ever to use this breakthrough capability morning, noon, and night.9

Automatic Conversation Boost. Now when you’re having a conversation in a busy restaurant or office, Conversation Boost will automatically amplify the voice of the person you’re talking to while minimizing the distracting noises around you. And with the new microphones, transducer, and amplifier, your voice will sound clearer and more natural than ever.8

Hearing Test and Hearing Aid. With a better fit and increased noise cancellation, you can now take a scientifically validated Hearing Test in a broader range of everyday background conditions — from the comfort of your home. And if you have mild to moderate hearing loss, you can use the improved Hearing Aid feature wherever you go.7

Hearing Protection. In addition to passive noise reduction from the ear tips, active Hearing Protection helps prevent exposure to loud environmental noise. Machine learning on the H2 chip reduces noise 48,000 times per second while maintaining natural and vibrant sound for whatever you’re listening to.17

Experience

Magic to your ears.

AirPods Pro 3 are packed with features that make even the simplest moments seem extraordinary. From the all-new Live Translation feature6 to superconvenient camera control,11 there’s so much more to AirPods than meets the ear.

New Siri AI. Get more done every day with hands-free access to an even more powerful and personalized AI assistant on your iPhone. Ask open-ended questions, brainstorm, and have full conversations.18

Available in select languages and regions. For more information, see Feature Availability.

Announce Notifications. Siri can read out messages and alerts as they arrive, and you can respond with just your voice.20 With Siri Interactions, you can even use intuitive head gestures — like a nod or a shake — to answer or ignore calls and texts.15

Audio Sharing. Easily share what you’re watching or listening to with a friend.15 Just bring their AirPods near the iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV you’re connected to. And voilà.

All-day battery life

They’re workin’ 9 to 5.

The MagSafe Charging Case is full of helpful features — like a built-in speaker and more powerful Precision Finding — that let you keep track of your AirPods Pro 3 no matter where they are.21 And now just a single charge will take you all the way through the workday. Plus overtime.

2x more Active Noise Cancellation compared with AirPods Pro 2. World's best Active Noise Cancellation evaluation tested in July 2025 in accordance with IEC 60268-24 as compared with best-selling commercially available wireless in-ear headphones.

Compared with AirPods Pro 2.

Testing conducted by Apple in July and August 2025 using preproduction AirPods Pro 3 with MagSafe Charging Case paired with preproduction iPhone 17 Pro units, all with prerelease software. The playlist consisted of 358 unique audio tracks purchased from the iTunes Store (256-Kbps AAC encoding). Listening time was up to 8 hours when volume was set to 50% and Active Noise Cancellation was enabled. With Spatial Audio and Head Tracking enabled, listening time was up to 7.5 hours. Testing consisted of full AirPods Pro battery discharge while playing audio until the first AirPod Pro stopped playback. Battery life depends on device settings, environment, usage, and many other factors.

Compatible hardware and software required. Works with compatible content in supported apps. Not all content available in Dolby Atmos. iPhone with TrueDepth camera required to create a personal profile for Personalized Spatial Audio, which will sync across Apple devices running the latest operating system software, including iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and tvOS. Personalized Spatial Audio is not available when using other devices.

Built-in heart rate monitor is intended for use during workouts with the Fitness app and compatible third-party apps on iPhone running iOS 26 and later. Refer to support.apple.com/123184 for more information.

Available on compatible Apple devices with the latest operating system software when paired with compatible AirPods with the latest firmware when Apple Intelligence is turned on. Available in beta. Some features may not be available in all regions or languages; for more information, see Feature Availability.

The Hearing Aid feature has received FDA authorization. The Hearing Test and Hearing Aid features are supported on AirPods Pro 2 and later with the latest firmware when paired with a compatible iPhone or iPad with iOS 18 or iPadOS 18 and later and are intended for people 18 years old or older. The Hearing Aid feature is also supported on a compatible Mac with macOS Sequoia and later. It is intended for people with perceived mild to moderate hearing loss.

Supported on AirPods Pro 2 and later with the latest firmware when paired with a compatible iPhone running iOS 26 and later. This feature may not be available in all regions or all languages. View complete list.

67% more battery life compared with AirPods Pro 2. Testing conducted by Apple in July and August 2025 using preproduction AirPods Pro 3 with MagSafe Charging Case paired with preproduction iPhone 17 Pro units, all with prerelease software. Both volume and amplification level were set to 50% and Transparency was enabled. Testing consisted of full AirPods Pro battery discharge with the Hearing Aid feature on, with no audio playing back from iPhone, until the first AirPod Pro was fully discharged. Battery life depends on device settings, environment, usage, and many other factors.

AirPods Pro 3 are dust, sweat, and water resistant for non-water sports and exercise. Products including charging case were tested under controlled laboratory conditions, and have a rating of IP57 under IEC standard 60529. Dust, sweat, and water resistance are not permanent conditions and resistance might decrease as a result of normal wear. Do not attempt to charge when wet; refer to support.apple.com/kb/HT210711 for cleaning and drying instructions.

Available on compatible devices running iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 and later when paired with AirPods 4, AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation, or AirPods Pro 2 and later.

Compared with AirPods Pro 2. Expanded Precision Finding works with AirPods Pro 3 paired with iPhone Air or iPhone 15 or later (excluding iPhone 16e); availability varies by region. Visit apple.com/uwb for more information.

Testing conducted by Apple in July 2025 using AirPods Pro 3 paired with iPhone 16 with prerelease AirPods firmware and iOS 26. Noise reduction was tested in accordance with IEC 60268-24. Comparison made against the best-selling wireless in-ear headphones commercially available at the time of testing. Performance depends on device settings, environment, and many other factors.

Up to 4x more Active Noise Cancellation compared with original AirPods Pro and AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation when tested in accordance with IEC 60268-24.

Requires a compatible Apple device running the latest operating system software.

Requires a paired Apple Intelligence–enabled iPhone and Bluetooth headphones with device and Siri language set to English or Spanish. For feature and language availability and system requirements see support.apple.com/121115.

The Hearing Protection feature works with AirPods Pro 2 and later with the latest firmware when paired with a compatible iPhone, iPad, or Mac with iOS 18, iPadOS 18, or macOS Sequoia and later. The feature is not available in all regions or all languages. View complete list. See support.apple.com/120850 for total attenuation and more information. The Hearing Protection feature is not suitable for protection against extremely loud impulse sounds, such as gunfire, fireworks, or jackhammers, or against sustained sounds louder than 110 dBA.

Some features may not be available in all regions or languages. Some devices may not be available in all regions. Available in English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish to start. Siri AI will not be initially available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS. Siri AI is not available for users under 13. Certain Apple Intelligence features that rely on server-side models are subject to daily usage limits, including but not limited to Siri AI, Intelligent Photo Editing Tools, Image Playground, and AFM 3 Cloud models in Shortcuts. Daily limits may vary by feature, request complexity, system demand, system policies, and other factors. Expanded access to such features will be available for a fee in the future. Use of these features is subject to the Apple Intelligence Terms and Conditions. Learn more at support.apple.com/148587. Hands-free access to Siri AI works on all AirPods.

Requires an Apple Account and a compatible Apple device running the latest operating system software.

Siri and activating with just “Siri” may not be available in all languages or in all areas, and features may vary by area. Compatible device and internet access required. Devices must support and have the latest operating system software.

MagSafe charging requires a compatible MagSafe charger. Wireless charging requires a Qi-certified wireless charger. AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Pro 2 charging case also works with the Apple Watch charger or USB-C connector.
